literal_meaning: হাতে থাকা লক্ষ্মীকে পায়ে ঠেলে দেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To waste an opportunity through carelessness
similar_in_english: To look a gift horse in the mouth
To kill the goose that lays the golden eggs
example_sentences_in_bangla: উসকানিতে সে হাতের লক্ষ্মী পায়ে ঠেলে দিল।
ব্যবসার প্রস্তাব না নিয়ে তিনি হাতের লক্ষ্মী পায়ে ঠেললেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Out of arrogance, he kicked away the good fortune right in his hands.
By rejecting the business offer, he foolishly wasted a golden opportunity.
history: This idiom references Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, symbolizing the folly of squandering readily available good fortune.
note: The idiom emphasizes the cultural value placed on not taking prosperity for granted in Bengali society.
